nodes.Name: Bool
nodes.DocComment:
A Bool is an atomic boolean value.
The zero value is false.

Bool must not be copied after first use.

nodes.Name: Load
nodes.DocComment: Load atomically loads and returns the value stored in x.

nodes.Name: Store
nodes.DocComment: Store atomically stores val into x.

nodes.Name: Swap
nodes.DocComment: Swap atomically stores new into x and returns the previous value.

nodes.Name: CompareAndSwap
nodes.DocComment: CompareAndSwap executes the compare-and-swap operation for the boolean value x.

nodes.Name: b32
nodes.DocComment: b32 returns a uint32 0 or 1 representing b.

For testing *Pointer[T]'s methods can be inlined.
Keep in sync with cmd/compile/internal/test/inl_test.go:TestIntendedInlining.

nodes.Name: Pointer
nodes.DocComment:
A Pointer is an atomic pointer of type *T. The zero value is a nil *T.

Pointer must not be copied after first use.

nodes.Name: Load
nodes.DocComment: Load atomically loads and returns the value stored in x.

nodes.Name: Store
nodes.DocComment: Store atomically stores val into x.

nodes.Name: Swap
nodes.DocComment: Swap atomically stores new into x and returns the previous value.

nodes.Name: CompareAndSwap
nodes.DocComment: CompareAndSwap executes the compare-and-swap operation for x.

nodes.Name: Int32
nodes.DocComment:
An Int32 is an atomic int32. The zero value is zero.

Int32 must not be copied after first use.

nodes.Name: Load
nodes.DocComment: Load atomically loads and returns the value stored in x.

nodes.Name: Store
nodes.DocComment: Store atomically stores val into x.

nodes.Name: Swap
nodes.DocComment: Swap atomically stores new into x and returns the previous value.

nodes.Name: CompareAndSwap
nodes.DocComment: CompareAndSwap executes the compare-and-swap operation for x.

nodes.Name: Add
nodes.DocComment: Add atomically adds delta to x and returns the new value.

nodes.Name: And
nodes.DocComment:
And atomically performs a bitwise AND operation on x using the bitmask
provided as mask and returns the old value.

nodes.Name: Or
nodes.DocComment:
Or atomically performs a bitwise OR operation on x using the bitmask
provided as mask and returns the old value.

nodes.Name: noCopy
nodes.DocComment:
noCopy may be added to structs which must not be copied
after the first use.

See https://golang.org/issues/8005#issuecomment-190753527
for details.

Note that it must not be embedded, due to the Lock and Unlock methods.

nodes.Name: Lock
nodes.DocComment: Lock is a no-op used by -copylocks checker from `go vet`.

nodes.Name: align64
nodes.DocComment:
align64 may be added to structs that must be 64-bit aligned.
This struct is recognized by a special case in the compiler
and will not work if copied to any other package.
